AddDiskReplicaPair.description_en: Adds a replication pair to a replication pair-consistent group. You can use a replication pair-consistent group to batch manage replication pairs. When you call this operation, you can specify parameters, such as ReplicaGroupId, ReplicaPairId, and ClientToken, in the request
AddDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 调用AddDiskReplicaPair接口，并可以指定ReplicaGroupId、ReplicaPairId、ClientToken等参数，添加复制对到一致性复制组，最终通过一致性复制组，您可以批量管理复制对

ApplyLensService.description_zh: 开通块存储数据洞察（CloudLens for EBS）

BindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Bind disks into a enterprise-level snapshot policy
BindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用BindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy绑定云盘到企业级快照策略

CancelLensService.description_zh: 取消块存储数据洞察（CloudLens for EBS）

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group to which an Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resource belongs

ClearPairDrill.description_en: Clears the disaster recovery drills that were initiated from the secondary disk of a replication pair and deletes the auto-created drill disks
ClearPairDrill.description_zh: 该接口可以清理之前复制对从盘启动的容灾演练，并尝试删除自动创建出来的演练盘

ClearReplicaGroupDrill.description_en: Clears the disaster recovery drills that were initiated from the secondary disks of a replication pair-consistent group and deletes the auto-created drill disks
ClearReplicaGroupDrill.description_zh: 该接口可以清理之前复制组从盘启动的容灾演练，并尝试删除自动创建出来的演练盘

CreateApp.description_en: Creates an app with the centralized role

CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster.description_en: Creates a dedicated block storage cluster by calling the CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster operation with parameters such as Azone, Capacity, Type, and PeriodUnit
CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster.description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedBlockStorageCluster接口，并指定Azone、Capacity、Type、PeriodUnit等参数，创建专属块存储集群

CreateDiagnoseReport.description_en: Creates a diagnostic report for a specified resource

CreateDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 创建一个一致性复制组

CreateDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 创建一个云盘异步复制关系

CreateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Creates an enterprise-level snapshot policy by calling CreateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy
CreateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用CreateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy创建企业级快照策略

DeleteApp.description_en: Deletes an application using the centralized role

DeleteDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 删除一个异步复制关系

DeleteEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy删除企业级快照策略

DescribeApps.description_en: Queries application information as a centralized role

DescribeDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDisk.description_en: Queries information about one or more cloud disks that you have created in a dedicated block storage cluster
DescribeDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDisk.description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的专属块存储集群的云盘信息

DescribeDiskMonitorData.description_en: Queries fine-grained monitoring data of a disk
DescribeDiskMonitorData.description_zh: 查询单个云盘的秒级监控数据

DescribeDiskReplicaGroups.description_en: Queries information about one or more replication pair-consistent groups in a specified region
DescribeDiskReplicaGroups.description_zh: 查询在指定地域下，一个或多个一致性复制组的信息

DescribeDiskReplicaPairProgress.description_en: Queries the replication progress of a replication pair
DescribeDiskReplicaPairProgress.description_zh: 查询复制对的同步进度

DescribeDiskReplicaPairs.description_en: Queries information about one or more replication pairs in a specified region
DescribeDiskReplicaPairs.description_zh: 查询指定地域下，一个或多个异步复制关系的信息

DescribeEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Queries enterprise-level snapshot policies by specifying parameters such as PolicyIds, ResourceGroupId, and Tag
DescribeEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用DescribeEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy接口，并可以指定PolicyIds、ResourceGroupId、Tag等参数，查找企业级快照策略

DescribeLensMonitorDisks.description_en: Queries one or more block storage cloud disks that you have created
DescribeLensMonitorDisks.description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的块存储云盘

DescribeLensServiceStatus.description_en: Queries the status of the EBS Lens service activated by the user
DescribeLensServiceStatus.description_zh: 查询用户开通ebs数据洞察服务状态

DescribeMetricData.description_en: Queries the monitoring metrics of a resource

DescribePairDrills.description_en: Queries the disaster recovery drills that were performed on the replication pair whose secondary disk resides in a specific region
DescribePairDrills.description_zh: 该接口用于查询当前地域的盘作为复制对从端时，曾经对复制对所启动的容灾演练

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions supported by Elastic Block Storage (EBS) features, including asynchronous replication, EBS Lens, and dedicated block storage clusters
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询块存储EBS相关功能异步复制、数据洞察、专属块存储集群支持的地域信息

DescribeReplicaGroupDrills.description_en: Queries the disaster recovery drills that were performed on the replication pair-consistent group whose secondary disk resides in a specific region
DescribeReplicaGroupDrills.description_zh: 该接口用于查询当前地域的盘作为复制组从端时，曾经对复制组所启动的容灾演练

DescribeSolutionInstanceConfiguration.description_en: Queries the default configurations of a solution
DescribeSolutionInstanceConfiguration.description_zh: 查询解决方案默认配置

DescribeUserTagKeys.description_en: Centralized Role: Query User Disk Snapshot tagKeys
DescribeUserTagKeys.description_zh: 中心化角色：查询用户云盘快照tagKeys

DescribeUserTagValues.description_en: Centralized Role: Query User Disk and Snapshot tagValues
DescribeUserTagValues.description_zh: 中心化角色：查询用户云盘快照tagValues

FailoverDiskReplicaGroup.description_en: Enables the failover feature for replication pairs in a replication pair-consistent group. When the primary disks of specific replication pairs in a replication pair-consistent group fail, you can call this operation to enable the read and write permissions on the secondary disks
FailoverDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 启用一致性复制组中复制对的故障切换功能。当一致性复制组中某些复制对的主盘出现故障时，可以调用该接口恢复从盘的读写权限

FailoverDiskReplicaPair.description_en: Enables the failover feature for replication pairs
FailoverDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 启用异步复制关系的故障切换功能

GetReport.description_en: Retrieves a user usage report by report ID using the centralized role
GetReport.description_zh: 中心化角色：使用reportId获取用户使用报告

ListReplicaEdgeSupported.description_en: Queries the destination regions and zones that support asynchronous replication for a specified zone
ListReplicaEdgeSupported.description_zh: 查询某个可用区支持的异步复制目的地域和可用区

ListReports.description_en: Queries the historical report list for a specified application using a centralized role
ListReports.description_zh: 中心化角色：查询指定应用历史报告列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are added to EBS resources, or queries the IDs and tags of resources in a non-default resource group
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个EBS资源已经绑定的标签信息，或查询指定的非默认资源组内的资源ID及标签信息

ModifyApp.description_en: Modifies an app from a centralized role

ModifyDedicatedBlockStorageClusterAttrib.description_en: Modifies the information of a dedicated elastic block storage cluster
ModifyDedicatedBlockStorageClusterAttrib.description_zh: 修改专属块存储集群的信息

ModifyDiskReplicaGroup.description_en: Modifies the name, description, or Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of a replication pair-consistent group
ModifyDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 修改一致性复制组的名称、描述信息或者RPO

ModifyDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 修改一个云盘异步复制关系

QueryDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThr.description_en: Query the throughput status of a dedicated block storage cluster disk which has been set through the SetDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThroughput API
QueryDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThr.description_zh: 查询通过SetDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThroughput API设置的专用块存储集群磁盘的吞吐量状态

QueryDedicatedBlockStorageClusterInvento.description_en: Queries the capacity trend data of a dedicated Elastic Block Storage (EBS) cluster within a specific time period, including the available capacity and total capacity
QueryDedicatedBlockStorageClusterInvento.description_zh: 调用QueryDedicatedBlockStorageClusterInventoryData查询指定时间范围下，专属块存储集群容量趋势数据，包括可用容量和总容量

RemoveDiskReplicaPair.description_en: Removes a replication pair from a replication pair-consistent group. After a replication pair is removed from a replication pair-consistent group, the pair is disassociated from the group but is not deleted
RemoveDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 移除一致性复制组中的复制对。移除复制对只是解除了复制对和一致性复制组的绑定关系，不会删除复制对

ReprotectDiskReplicaGroup.description_en: Enables the reverse replication feature for replication pairs that belong to a replication pair-consistent group. After reverse replication is enabled, data stored on the original secondary disks is replicated to the original primary disks. When a reverse replication is being performed, the primary and secondary sites of the replication pair-consistent group remain unchanged, but data is replicated from the secondary site to the primary site
ReprotectDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 启用一致性复制组中复制对的反向复制功能。启用反向复制功能后，可以将原灾备站点的云盘数据复制到原生产站点的云盘当中。反向复制数据时，一致性复制组中原有的站点信息不变，主从关系颠倒

ReprotectDiskReplicaPair.description_en: Enables the reverse replication feature for a replication pair
ReprotectDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 启用异步复制关系的反向复制功能

SetDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThrou.description_en: In the elastic type dedicated block storage cluster, you can easily achieve the specified throughput (Bps) for the target disk. You only need to set the cloud disk ID and the target throughput, simplifying the process of configuring
SetDedicatedBlockStorageClusterDiskThrou.description_zh: 弹性型专属存储集群内，方便您实现指定云盘目标的bps值的功能；只需要设置云盘ID和目标吞吐，简化您设置性能控制、修改预配置、调节云盘burst的步骤

StartDiskReplicaGroup.description_en: Enables the async replication feature for replication pairs that belong to a replication pair-consistent group. The first time the async replication feature is enabled for the replication pairs, the system performs a full synchronization to synchronize all data from disks at the primary site (primary disks) to disks at the secondary site (secondary disks). Then, the system periodically synchronizes incremental data based on the recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group
StartDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 启动一致性复制组中复制对的异步复制功能。首次同步时，系统会先进行一次全量同步，之后会按照保证RPO（Recovery Point Object）的时间周期内进行增量同步

StartDiskReplicaPair.description_en: Activates the async replication feature for a specific replication pair
StartDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 为指定的异步复制关系激活异步复制功能

StartPairDrill.description_en: Starts a disaster recovery drill to ensure the continued replication and clone the data from the last recovery point of the secondary disk to a new disk. This helps you test the completeness and correctness of applications that are deployed on the disaster recovery site on a regular basis
StartPairDrill.description_zh: 您可以通过演练切换功能确保复制流程持续运行，同时将从盘最近恢复点的数据克隆至一块新的云盘，定期验证容灾站点应用的完整性和正确性

StartReplicaGroupDrill.description_en: Starts a disaster recovery drill in a replication pair-consistent group to ensure the continued replication and restores data from the latest recovery point of secondary disks to new disks. This helps test the completeness and correctness of applications that are deployed on the disaster recovery site on a regular basis
StartReplicaGroupDrill.description_zh: 您可以通过演练切换功能确保复制流程持续运行，同时将从盘最近恢复点的数据克隆至一块新的云盘，定期验证容灾站点应用的完整性和正确性

StopDiskReplicaGroup.description_en: Stops a replication pair-consistent group. This operation stops all replication pairs in the replication pair-consistent group
StopDiskReplicaGroup.description_zh: 停止一致性复制组中复制对的异步复制功能

StopDiskReplicaPair.description_zh: 为指定的异步复制关系停止异步复制功能

TagResources.description_en: Creates tags and adds the tags to Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的EBS资源统一绑定标签

UnbindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Unbind disks from a enterprise-level snapshot policy
UnbindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用UnbindEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy为云盘解除企业级快照策略绑定

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from specified Elastic Block Storage (EBS) resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的EBS资源统一解绑标签

UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Modifies the configuration of an enterprise-level snapshot policy
UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 调用UpdateEnterpriseSnapshotPolicy修改企业级快照策略配置

UpdateSolutionInstanceAttribute.description_en: Updates the attributes of a solution instance
UpdateSolutionInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 更新解决方案实例属性
